name: Reimei no Lavendura
original_name: 黎明のラヴェンデュラ
source:
Mankind has populated the entire galaxy. But as the need for military forces is decreased, a lot of military facilities are downgraded to training schools. Main character is the instructor of a girl training corps. Together they board the training space ship Lavendula and jump out into the space...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
人类已经遍布整个银河。随着军事力量需求下降，许多军事设施被降级为训练学校。主人公是女子训练部队的教官。他与成员们一同登上训练用宇宙飞船Lavendula，跃入太空…

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-june-2005-ayakashibito.html]vndbreview[/url]]
